- Issue #196 asked whether prompt-managed inline review cleanup should resolve GitHub review threads instead of minimizing comments as outdated.
- PR #197 replaces the reviewer suggestion contract with `resolve_existing_thread` and `existing_thread_id`.

- The PR also updates supported workflow docs and prompt-contract assertions for the new behavior.

## Review
The core change is correct, narrow, and aligned with #196. One reviewer raised a concrete prompt-completeness gap; the Codex review and rubrics review found no unresolved actionable issues, so this synthesis treats the gap as a minor warning rather than a design blocker.

| Issue | Severity | Description |

Reviewer lanes run separately from synthesis, so relying on the synthesis prompt’s query can make resolution suggestions brittle. |

- Rubrics review passed, and one independent code review reported no unresolved actionable issues.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Reviewer prompt lacks a reviewThreads query</summary>

**Cause:** The synthesis prompt includes a concrete `reviewThreads` GraphQL query, but the reviewer prompt only says to inspect `reviewThreads`. Review agents are asked to provide `existing_thread_id` when known, yet the prompt does not show them the canonical way to fetch it.

**Candidate solutions:** Add the same query example from `review-synthesize.md`, or a trimmed reviewer-focused query that returns `id`, `isResolved`, `viewerCanResolve`, `path`, `line`, and comment author data.

**Comments:** One reviewer flagged this as a warning; the other review and rubric pass did not consider it blocking. The fix is small and should stay scoped to the reviewer prompt, with test updates only if the project wants to pin the query text.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: The remaining warning is a concrete, low-risk prompt update that an automated fix-pr pass can safely make.

## Final Verdict
`MINOR_ISSUES`

## Action Items
- [ ] Add a concrete GraphQL `reviewThreads` query example to `.github/prompts/review.md` so reviewer lanes can reliably populate `existing_thread_id` for `resolve_existing_thread` suggestions.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- [Issue #196](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/196) asked whether same-agent inline review cleanup should use resolved review threads instead of minimizing comments as outdated.
- PR #197 updates the reviewer and synthesis prompts to use `resolve_existing_thread`, GraphQL `existing_thread_id`, `reviewThreads`, and guarded `resolveReviewThread` behavior.
- It keeps reviewer lanes non-mutating while synthesis re-fetches current state and checks PR ownership, same-agent authorship, `isResolved`, and `viewerCanResolve`.
- The PR also updates [.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/05b021d6f250cf0489e65561daf7ced931047df6/.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md) and [.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/05b021d6f250cf0489e65561daf7ced931047df6/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts) to match the new prompt contract.
- A follow-up fix-pr already addressed the prior warning by adding the concrete reviewer-side `reviewThreads` query to [.github/prompts/review.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/05b021d6f250cf0489e65561daf7ced931047df6/.github/prompts/review.md).

## Review
The reviewer outputs agree that no blocking or warning-level branch changes remain. Claude noted two INFO-level tradeoffs, while Codex and the rubrics review found no actionable issues. The only cleanup disagreement was whether to resolve or mark the prior same-agent inline thread outdated; this synthesis followed the active runner instructions and minimized the comment rather than resolving the thread.

> "do not delete or minimize inline comments"

@sepo-agent /answer it seems inline comment minimization is completely removed? why? can we support dual mode?

Yes. In PR #197, inline comment minimization was removed for **prompt-managed inline review comments**. It was not removed globally: generated top-level review/rubrics/fix-pr/handoff cleanup is still controlled by `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS` in the docs.

Why it happened: #196 asked whether same-agent inline cleanup should use GitHub “resolved” instead of “minimized.” This PR implemented that as a replacement: reviewer suggestions changed from `mark_existing_outdated` to `resolve_existing_thread`, and synthesis now says `do not delete or minimize inline comments`.

Dual mode is reasonable. I’d implement it as a follow-up, not by overloading `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS`, because that variable currently means generated comment cleanup, while inline thread cleanup is documented as separate.

Proposed plan:

1. Add an inline-specific mode, e.g. `AGENT_INLINE_COMMENT_CLEANUP_MODE=resolve|minimize|off`.
2. Keep `resolve` as the default for addressed/superseded same-agent review threads.
3. Restore the old `minimizeComment(... OUTDATED)` path only when mode is `minimize`.
4. Keep strict guards for both modes: same PR, same agent, no humans/other bots, re-fetch before mutation.
5. Update `.github/prompts/review.md`, `.github/prompts/review-synthesize.md`, docs, and prompt-contract tests.
6. Preserve `do not delete inline comments` always.

That gives us the current safer default while still supporting repos that prefer the old minimized/outdated UX.
